lesson.text: Quick memory: who gives you medicine? (Only your own grown-up.) Today: the things at home that can make you poorly.
Some bottles at home are not food or drink: cleaners, bleach, washing tablets, sprays. Many of them wear a warning sign: a red diamond.
A warning sign means: don't touch it, tell a grown-up. Grown-ups keep them up high, locked away.
Medicine can look like sweets, but it isn't. Only your own grown-up gives you medicine.
A tiny round battery? Give it to a grown-up, never put it in your mouth. Berries and mushrooms outside? Never eat them.
Try it in the world: open the practice kitchen and find the warning signs. Next: the child lock and never mixing cleaners, on the Middle track.

exercises.prompt: A red diamond on a bottle means...
exercises.explain: Danger: don't touch it, tell a grown-up.

exercises.prompt: Medicine is a kind of sweet.
exercises.explain: False: medicine is not a sweet. Only your grown-up gives it to you.

exercises.hint: The person who looks after you.
exercises.explain: Only your own grown-up gives you medicine.

exercises.prompt: You find a tiny round battery on the floor. You...
exercises.explain: Give it to a grown-up: batteries must never go in a mouth.

exercises.prompt: Shiny red berries in the garden are safe to eat.
exercises.explain: False: never eat berries or mushrooms from outside.
Up high, locked away, where small children can't reach.

exercises.prompt: Food and drink, or not food?
exercises.explain: Juice and milk are drinks; bleach and washing tablets are not food.

exercises.prompt: Washing tablets look like sweets. You...
choices: never touch them and tell a grown-up
exercises.explain: Never touch them: tell a grown-up.

exercises.prompt: Someone swallowed something from a bottle with a warning sign. A grown-up...
exercises.explain: A grown-up calls the emergency number straight away.

exercises.prompt: A juice bottle always has juice in it.
exercises.hint: Someone might have poured something else in.
exercises.explain: False: only drink what a grown-up gives you.

exercises.prompt: You see a warning sign: put it in order.
exercises.explain: Don't touch it, then tell a grown-up.
